hypothesis: Previous completed H1 high/low supplies a fixed intraday liquidity reference; an M1 sweep and close-back-inside may create sparse 30-second reversal opportunities with more natural supply than daily/session levels.

configs.C01: First M1 bar per side/hour wicks beyond previous completed H1 high/low and closes back inside.
configs.C03: C02 plus rejection-side wick larger than opposite wick.
configs.C04: C02 plus M1 close also beyond its own midpoint in rejection direction.
